Beat 'grow' (and hook, thumbnail): '10 years at 12% a year, and that EMI money becomes ₹9.3 L' states 12% equity SIP growth as a certain outcome; nothing on screen or in the voice calls it an assumption (profile: assumed returns are stated as assumptions on screen). Fix: e.g. 'If it grows 12% a year (assumed)...' / 'could become', and an 'Assumed 12% a year' label on the stack.

Hook 'This ₹4,000 EMI costs you ₹9.3 L' (also description 'cost you lakhs', thumbnail 'Really costs'): the conclusion overstates what the numbers show. ₹9.3 L is what the whole ₹4,000 a month could grow to, but that money also bought the phones; Sharma also buys phones ('paid cash for a cheaper phone', and over 10 years he needs replacements too), and that spending is hidden. Fix: frame as what the EMI money could have become ('could have been ₹9.3 L'), or compute only the difference the cheaper cash phone frees up.

Beats 'deal'/'old': the app card shows 'Interest ₹0' and Priya endorses it ('Zero interest, fine'). Indian no-cost EMI usually still carries a bank processing fee plus 18% GST on the interest component (the interest is offset by a discount, and RBI has said zero-percent schemes load the interest elsewhere), so the viewer is told the deal truly costs nothing extra. Fix: have Priya qualify it (e.g. 'Zero interest? Plus fees and GST. But even so...') or drop the endorsement.
